review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that people can reach historical objects and artworks through computer, so public museums and art galleries are unnecessary. From my perspective, I am the opposite school of thought.

Admittedly, technology have positive impacts in bring efficient historical and cultural experiences. Chief of these is that technology, say, high-resolution images, three-dimensional reconstructions, virtual reality platforms can enable viewers to explore masterpieces and ancient artefacts in remarkable detail without leaving home. For instance, one of the most famous museums in the world, Louvre museum, offers opportunity to experience online exhibitions, which accessible to people over the world, helping many people pursue their passion. Added to this is that this suit those who cannot afford or have mobility issues, still access a vast range of cultural and historical heritages.

However, I believe that public museums and art galleries remain essential. Initially, online experience cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of feeling an artefact or artwork in person, evoking emotions and a sense of authenticity that digital images can convey. One clear example is Viet Nam, where many museums and galleries have been built to exhibit historical artworks or inventions in the past. Furthermore, museums and galleries as vital cultural hubs, symbolize the identity of a region, It is naturally follows that this as a magnet for tourism and a facilitator of bonding within the community.
In conclusion, I am convinced that even though technological tools bring new historical and cultural experiences for viewers, it cannot replace museums and galleries.

completion.comment: Bài có đủ mở bài, hai thân bài và kết bài.

review.overall: Em viết đủ bốn phần và có đúng cặp ý công nghệ hỗ trợ tiếp cận – bảo tàng vẫn cần thiết. Em có chuỗi công cụ số, ví dụ Louvre và ý trung tâm văn hóa. Tuy nhiên, mức tự soát chưa đạt: 'which accessible', 'this suit ... still access', 'It is naturally follows that this as a magnet' đều là lỗi câu cơ bản; 'digital images can convey' còn đảo ngược luận điểm trực tiếp. Em cần nghiêm túc viết lại các câu ấy, kiểm tra chủ ngữ, động từ và quy chiếu, rồi mới nộp bản sửa.

paragraphs: It is argued that people can view historical objects and artworks on a computer, leading some to believe that public museums and art galleries will no longer be needed. From my perspective, I am of the opposite school of thought.

Admittedly, technology has positive impacts by providing useful historical and cultural experiences. Chief of these is that technology, say, high-resolution images, three-dimensional reconstructions, virtual reality platforms, can enable viewers to explore masterpieces and ancient artefacts in remarkable detail without leaving home. For instance, one of the most famous museums in the world, Louvre museum, offers opportunities to experience online exhibitions, which are accessible to people around the world, helping many people pursue their passion. However, I believe that public museums and art galleries remain essential. Initially, online experience cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of seeing an artefact or artwork in person. Viewing an artefact or artwork in person can evoke emotions and a sense of authenticity that digital images cannot convey. One clear example is Viet Nam, where many museums and galleries have been built to exhibit historical artworks or inventions from the past. Seeing these original exhibits in person can help visitors feel connected to the people and events behind them. Furthermore, museums and galleries, as vital cultural hubs, symbolize the identity of a region. It naturally follows that they can attract tourists and facilitate bonding within the community.
In conclusion, I am convinced that even though technological tools bring new historical and cultural experiences to viewers, they cannot replace museums and galleries.

task.text:
Some people claim that public museums and art galleries will be no longer needed because people can see historical objects and works of art by using a computer.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
